intersections.note: Nebraska ends at 8th; no tab north (plate's diagonal NW edge just west). 8th centre taken midway between the top neat line (8th's north line, y~47-50) and the south block line (y~168-175); the lines at y~78 (dashed), ~100-110 and ~120-130 inside 8th are the 15" sewer and 6" water pipe

north of Amelia this street is printed only 'AVE.' (with 50'); 'DOLL' is printed on the same N-S street south of Amelia (continuous, same width), so recorded as Doll Avenue. A narrow empty tab of the plate (x 2300-2338, ~25 ft, no street lines or name) projects north opposite, off-centre to Doll; not treated as a continuation
street coming from the north in a tab of the plate (x 2682-2757, ~50 ft, 6" water pipe in it); name printed 'FIS...' and cut off by the plate's top edge; ends at 8th (nothing south: lots of block 51)
north of Amelia printed only 'AVE.'; 'PEDRETTI' printed on the same continuous N-S street near Foley Road, so recorded as Pedretti Avenue. No tab north of 8th here
corner: Nebraska's south end turns east into Amelia (Amelia's west end); Nebraska's west line bends at (1751,930) into the diagonal SW side of block 53
Amelia Avenue (printed 'AMELIA ... AVE.') west of Pedretti becomes 'CARNATION' east of it (Carnation's label is at x~3050-3550); recorded with the west name here, see the next entry
same point as Pedretti/Amelia: the E-W street changes name at Pedretti (Amelia west, Carnation east). Carnation printed 'CARNATION' with 'AVE.' further east (x~4000)
E-W leg of Doll (printed 'DOLL AVE.') ends at Pedretti; point on Pedretti's 30' section centreline (west line x~2930, east line x~2973)

notes: Strip a: x 0-2800 plus overlap to x 3100, full height. West and south-west of Nebraska/Amelia and Doll is open ground: St. Joseph Cemetery Assn. (west) and Cathedral Catholic Cemetery (centre), no streets; the lot lines in the cemetery (x~880, the box x~520-1300 / y~2030-2900), the orange subdivision band along the SW sides of block 53 (diagonal from (1760,970) to (1990,1490) and on to (2930,1860)), the blue/yellow bands around blocks 50 and 51 and the scan fold at x~1990 are not streets. Subdivision/estate lettering (THE ANTHONY, SIMON FEHR EST., THE ANTHONY OEHLER 2ND SUB., CHAS. PEDRETTI) is not streets. 'GREEN HILL PL. PRIVATE' leaving Pedretti eastward at y~2380-2420 (x>2976) is a private lane, not recorded. W. 8th Street (printed 'W. EIGHTH') runs straight along the top from the plate's diagonal NW edge east past Pedretti; its north line is the top neat line (y~47-50), south block line y~168-175 (about 80 ft between them); no width printed in this strip. Nebraska Avenue (printed 'NEBRASKA' and 'AVE.') is ~77 px wide (west line x~1751, block line x~1826); a '45'' printed in it near both ends (y~185 and ~878) is probably a lot dimension, not recorded as a width. Foley Road (printed 'FOLEY' at x~1100) runs straight along the bottom (north line y~2952 at x 500, ~2894 at x 1500, ~2805 at x 2930; the plate's bottom edge is its south side); '1300'' printed at its west end is a frontage length, not a width; no bends found.
